nudge-smoke-01.description: Smoke test of the nudge loop only (rounds=0, nudges<=2, doc v1, minimax-m2.7). Aborted after 4 tasks once the loop was seen to fire — it was never meant to finish, so its 4/71 is not a result.

phase3-holdout-02.description: First full 3-arm holdout sweep (Aven vs Python vs Ruby, 71 tasks each) on minimax-m2.7 with skill doc v1. Establishes the cross-language delta the campaign exists to measure. CAVEAT: ran before the toolPolicy fix of 2026-08-09, so python3/ruby were on the model's sandbox PATH under no-verify while aven was not — the control arms could check their work before submitting and the Aven arm could not, with nothing recording whether they did (4 of 142 control rows ran any shell command at all; none of those passed). Read the Aven-vs-control delta as a lower bound, not a clean comparison.

phase3-holdout-03.description: Same 3-arm holdout as -02 but on deepseek-v4-flash, with the nudge loop enabled (nudges<=2). Changes the model and adds nudging at once, so it is not a clean single-variable comparison against -02. CAVEAT: carries the same pre-2026-08-09 toolPolicy asymmetry as -02 — the control arms had an uninstrumented interpreter under no-verify (5 of 142 control rows ran a shell command, 3 of them passed), so the Aven-vs-control delta is a lower bound.

phase3-holdout-04.description: Aven arm only, on skill doc v2 and a compiler carrying the first round of benchmark-driven fixes (aven-lang e8a71f9). Drops the control arms to iterate faster on the Aven side.

phase3-holdout-05.description: Aven arm on aven-lang 430af37 with regenerated suites. Scored 95.5% pass / 53.7% first-shot after a retry pass corrected a selection bias (the excluded harness errors were disproportionately the previously-failing tasks). Remaining failures: complex-numbers, react, rest-api, alphametics. NOTE: measured the original memorisable zebra-puzzle, which was retired from holdout on 2026-08-01.

phase3-holdout-06.description: Re-baseline of holdout-05's configuration on aven-lang 86ee877, seven fixes newer (match-arm block bodies, undefined-default inference, array equality coercion, native Array.length, checker equality parity, S6 empty-element traversal, compact). Also raises the agent timeout 900s -> 1800s (fixes timeouts misfiled as dead-provider errors) and swaps in zebra-puzzle-generated. Purpose: know where failures sit on the current compiler before the diagnostic-format A/B. Scored 90.1% pass / 59.2% first-shot over 71 tasks after retrying ledger (harness error -> pass) and drawing a second sample for prism (agent timeout -> pass 14/14). Against holdout-05 only three tasks moved: react fixed (parse_error -> pass), prism lost to an agent stall, pov exposed a pre-existing checker hole where ambient methods do not satisfy open-row receiver constraints.

phase3-pilot-01.description: Phase 3 pilot: 10 tune tasks, 3 arms, 1 model, skill doc v0. Shakedown of the 3-arm pipeline end to end before committing to a full holdout sweep.

phase4-diagfmt-text-01.description: Diagnostic-format A/B, arm A (control). IV = how aven check diagnostics are rendered into the REPAIR prompt: default ariadne text, the rendering every previous sweep used. Everything else held fixed (deepseek-v4-flash, skill doc v2 dfa665f6, aven-lang 8ca8620, holdout 71, rounds 3, nudges 2, no-verify, hidden, 3 samples). Both arms ran concurrently so provider drift falls on both. Pre-registration — DV, bar, forbidden filters, stopping rule — is analysis/prereg-diagfmt-01.md, committed before the first attempt. Absolute numbers are NOT comparable to holdout-06: the skill doc is one commit newer. RESULT: null. Paired Wilcoxon on 71 per-task censored-round means: mean diff 0.019 rounds, p=0.874, 95% CI [-0.142,+0.179] excludes the 0.3-round bar in both directions (MDE ~0.226), so this is an informative null, not an underpowered one. Negative control passed (firstShotPass 49.8% vs 52.4%, p=0.594). CAVEAT: the IV fired on only 38%/30% of attempts, so a per-exposure effect of up to ~±0.5 rounds is NOT ruled out; the pre-registered secondary stratum that would have tested it had just 16 paired tasks. Full write-up: analysis/results-diagfmt-01.md.

phase4-diagfmt-agent-01.description: Diagnostic-format A/B, arm B (treatment). IV = how aven check diagnostics are rendered into the REPAIR prompt: --format agent, one line per diagnostic plus indented in:/at:/help:. Everything else held fixed (deepseek-v4-flash, skill doc v2 dfa665f6, aven-lang 8ca8620, holdout 71, rounds 3, nudges 2, no-verify, hidden, 3 samples). Full write-up: analysis/results-diagfmt-01.md.

phase4-layout-residue-smoke-01.description: Paid three-task smoke for the post-#71 layout-residue sweep: acronym, armstrong-numbers and hello-world, all first-shot passes. Confirmed skill-v4, aven-lang af52d49, its stable release-binary hash, hidden/no-verify and bubblewrap before the full spend. Resume keys are global rather than run-id-local, so the full command correctly skipped these three keys; they are the companion rows completing phase4-layout-residue-01's 71 logical tasks.

phase4-layout-residue-01.description: Ordinary Aven-only 71-task holdout sweep for #67's post-#71 layout-residue decision, pinned to aven-lang af52d49 and skill-v4 with deepseek-v4-flash, rounds 3, nudges 2, hidden/no-verify and bubblewrap. The main log contains the other 68 base rows; the three accepted smoke rows complete the logical sweep because global resume skipped their natural keys. The pre-registered harness retry recovered grade-school and rail-fence-cipher; camicia, complex-numbers, ledger, prism and rest-api remained harness errors and are excluded. A detached retry process outlived its wrapper and overlapped the resume, appending five surplus harness_error rows; the first replacement row to land per missing key is the canonical retry and the append-only surplus rows are retained but ignored. Scored 93.9% pass / 56.1% first-shot over 66 usable tasks. These absolute rates are NOT comparable to phase3-holdout-06 because both the compiler and skill doc moved. RESULT: no substantial layout residue. Source-plus-diagnostic review of all 45 failed usable rounds across 29 tasks found zero layout-attributed episodes or tasks, versus the pre-registered threshold of 7/66; the five model-authored failed rounds preserved inside otherwise excluded partial harness attempts were all type failures too. Recommendation: do not build the significant-indentation A/B on this evidence. Full write-up: analysis/results-layout-residue-01.md.
